forecast.rationale: At ~1.1x gross annual income on a single income, the carrying costs leave no slack for a surprise (roof, assessment, job wobble), and every stressor lands on one paycheck. The rental offset and the family-use plan compete for the same peak weeks, so at least one of the two assumptions must fail. One year is also the honeymoon-fade window: satisfaction surveys on discretionary property purchases dip hardest at months 9-18.
key_uncertainties: Whether the asker counts 'did not buy' as the right call
clarifying_questions: What fraction of the 20 weekends survive one soccer season?
